info.text:
Same salary, two life insurance formulas, $370,000 apart.

Hypothetical $60,000 earner: the 10x-income rule of thumb gives $600,000.
The DIME method (debt $20K + 10 years of income $600K + mortgage $250K + education $100K) gives $970,000.
Needs-based versions subtract existing assets: minus $50K savings and a $60K work policy = $860,000.
In the January 2026 Insurance Barometer Study, 38% of US adults said they need life insurance or more of it.

Sources: LIMRA & Life Happens 2026 Insurance Barometer Study; Kiplinger; OneDigital. Example numbers are hypothetical.
News and education, not financial advice.
